title: Kimi K2.6:cloud Mid-Tier AI Integration (qwen → K2.6:cloud → Claude Opus ladder)
rationale: Add a paid-cloud Ollama tier (kimi-k2.6:cloud) between local qwen2.5-coder:7b and Claude Opus to recover the 62% of currently-Claude tasks that don't need Claude depth. User-locked decisions 2026-05-10: budget cap 100K tokens/session (~$10) with fail-closed at 90K; AGGRESSIVE escalation (any context>8K escalates qwen→K2.6:cloud, no confidence-signal gating); two-pass safety pattern (K2 generates → Claude scrutinizes against PRISM SAFETY RAILS, returns PASS|REVISE|FAIL); Wave 5.5 timing (between cyrilXBT B1-B6 and Company Brain D1-D5). HOOK-SYNERGY blocks K2-K12 because every Edit on AISystemRouterEngine.ts currently waits for full PreToolUse hook stack (50+ minute hangs).
